btn_install.ha: Shigar da manhajar idan ba ka da ita
btn_install.en: Install the app if you don't have it

hint_1.ha: Yin sikanin QR da ke kan allon RayTok na ɗayan wayar yana kawo ka nan. Idan an shigar da manhajar za ta buɗe nan take; idan ba haka ba, shigar da ita da maɓallin sama ka sake sikanin QR.
hint_1.en: Scanning the QR on the other phone's RayTok screen brings you here. If the app is installed it opens right away; if not, install it with the button above and scan the QR again.

hint_2.ha: Dole wayoyin biyu su kasance a Wi-Fi ɗaya (ko hotspot na ɗaya). Ba a buƙatar intanet.
hint_2.en: Both phones must be on the same Wi-Fi (or one phone's hotspot). No internet needed.

hint_3.ha: Bayanin haɗin da ke kan sandar adireshi shi ne adireshin gida na wannan wayar da lambar tabbatarwa ta amfani sau ɗaya. Ba shi da ma'ana a wajen wannan Wi-Fi kuma yana daina aiki da zarar mai masauki ya rufe allon.
hint_3.en: The connection info in the address bar is that phone's local address and a one-time verification code. It means nothing unless you're on the same Wi-Fi, and it stops working as soon as the host closes the screen.

msg_no_info.ha: Wannan mahaɗin ba shi da bayanin haɗi. Don Allah sake sikanin QR da ke kan ɗayan allon.
msg_no_info.en: This link has no connection info. Please scan the QR on the other screen again.

msg_android.ha: Idan an shigar da manhajar za ta buɗe nan take. In ba haka ba, danna maɓallin ƙasa.
msg_android.en: If the app is installed it will open right away. If not, tap the button below.

msg_ios.ha: Wannan mahaɗin na manhajar RayTok ta Android ne. Babu manhajar iPhone tukuna.
msg_ios.en: This link is for the Android RayTok app. There is no iPhone app yet.
